title: Mike's Bike Ride Home
summary: A boy named Mike takes a bike ride to the lake using silent e words.

pages.text: Mike had a bike and he liked to ride.
pages.scene: A boy with a red bike standing proudly outside his home

pages.text: One fine day Mike rode his bike to the lake.
pages.scene: Mike pedaling fast on a sunny path with green trees

pages.text: The bike could make him go very fast.
pages.scene: Mike speeding down a slope, wind in his hair

pages.text: He saw a huge cake shop by the road.
pages.scene: A bakery storefront with cakes in the window

pages.text: Mike did stop and take a look inside.
pages.scene: Mike peeking through the shop window, eyes wide

pages.text: The baker made a nice cake with plum.
pages.scene: Baker displaying a beautiful homemade cake

pages.text: Come take a bite, the baker said with a smile.
pages.scene: Baker offering Mike a slice of cake

pages.text: Mike sat and ate the cake at the shop.
pages.scene: Mike enjoying cake at a small table

pages.text: The cake was fine and Mike felt brave.
pages.scene: Mike eating happily, more confident and happy

pages.text: Mike rode his bike back home on the same path.
pages.scene: Mike biking back, sunset painting the sky orange

pages.text: He made a new friend at the cake shop!
pages.scene: Mike waving goodbye to the baker
Mike home with his bike, smiling at the memory
